messages:
Priya: Heads up — PartnerX flagged a billing mismatch for mid-cycle plan upgrades + reseller surcharge stacking. Need quick sync on how we cascade ratecards and do proration.
Ethan: Do we have the contract snippet? could be order-of-ops issue: partner revshare vs reseller discount.
Priya: Paste from SOW: 'Partner revenue share is applied to gross usage before customer-level reseller discounts; proration for upgrades is proportional to time on plan.' They interpreted it differently.
Marta: Current implementation (summary): effective_customer_price = base_price * (1 - reseller_discount) * (1 - partner_revshare)
Sam: That math will undercount the partner share vs legal text. If partner revshare is meant to be applied to gross, partner gets less under current formula. Example: base $100, reseller 10%, partner 20% -> our calc = 100*(0.9)*(0.8)=72 -> partner cut = ? ambiguous.
Ethan: Example calc they expect: gross=100 -> partner_share=100*0.2=20 -> post_partner=80 -> customer_discount=80*0.1=8 -> customer_billed=72. Partner still gets $20. Under current comp, partner receives 100*(1-0.9*0.8)? unclear.
Marta: Ah ok — so system should emit both intermediate amounts so downstream handlers (finance/ledger) can attribute correctly.
Priya: Proposal: marketplace webhook schema v2 should include: gross_amount, partner_share_amount, post_partner_amount, customer_discount_amount, customer_billed_amount, proration_seconds, proration_factor. That makes reconciliation deterministic.
InfraBot: Note: schema bump will require connector change + partner notification. Recommend feature-flag rollout and two-week compatibility window. :robot_face:
Sam: Rounding policy: finance wants centrically-rounded ledger entries after each step (round to cents after partner_share calc, then after discount). Current end-only rounding causes 1-3 cent disputes.
Ethan: Agree. Also need a rule for cascading discounts vs additive: some partners want discounts subtracted vs multiplied. Must be explicit boolean 'discount_application' = 'cascade'|'stack-additive'.
Marta: Implementation plan from eng: 1) add fields + flags to webhook 2) add unit tests with numeric table (see below) 3) update billing worker to perform stepwise rounding 4) backfill reconciliation job for last 90 days to produce correction credits if delta>=$0.50.
Priya: Small numeric table for tests (copy/paste):
```
base=123.45
partner_pct=0.15
reseller_pct=0.07
gross=123.45
partner_share=18.5175 -> round 18.52
post_partner=104.93
reseller_discount=7.3451 -> round 7.35
customer_billed=97.58
ledger_rows: partner: 18.52, discount: 7.35, net_revenue: 97.58
```
Ethan: For proration when upgrading mid-cycle: proration_factor = seconds_on_old / seconds_in_cycle for old plan credit; apply same stepwise operations per prorated amount.
Sam: Dispute runbook idea: if partner claims >$1 discrepancy, create ticket in billing-disputes with CSV export of per-request events, our calculation, and suggested credit.
Priya: Action items: - Marta: PR for webhook schema + tests by Wed EOD. - Ethan: Draft partner notice & legal note for SOW clarification by Thu. - Sam: Reconcile policy doc + dispute runbook draft by next Mon. - InfraBot: schedule feature-flag rollout stub for QA environment.
Marta: I'll also add an integration test that replays historical usage for the top 5 partners to catch any >$0.50 deltas.
Ethan: +1. Also we should coordinate with Sales ops to freeze partner billing exports until backfill is done.
Priya: Thanks team — will triage priorities in the Partnerships weekly sync. Ping me for blockers. :eyes:
Sam: Noted. I'll start the dispute template now and link it here when ready.
InfraBot: Deploy checklist created: schema-change, FF toggle, partner-notice-draft, backfill-job. Added to #release-war-room.
